title: No tests included for either service — cache fallback chain, case handling, and write paths unverified
reasoning: The feature reports tests: [] and no test files were included or omitted; the only test infrastructure evidence is the vitest script in package.json (line 15). The most behavior-critical logic — the KV → upstream-refresh → D1 fallback chain in resolveTokens (which decides 200 vs 500 for the whole token API), the case-sensitive getToken path, the ON CONFLICT column lists, and the silent upsert failure swallow — has no test coverage among the included files. These are exactly the paths where regressions (e.g. fallback ordering, cache-envelope validation at line 128, limit clamping) would silently change API behavior.
recommendation: Add unit tests for both services with injected fetcher/KV/SQL mocks: cache hit, cache miss→refresh, fetch failure→D1 fallback, all-miss→TokenListError, malformed KV envelope treated as miss, case-insensitive getToken, conflict-update column behavior, and limit edge cases.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No test files were included for this feature and the feature metadata lists no linked tests.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parameterized test over resolveTokens: (a) KV hit returns cached tokens without calling fetcher; (b) KV miss + fetch failure + non-empty D1 returns D1 rows; (c) all miss → TokenListError.
minimumFixScope: New test file(s) under apps/api/test/ covering token-list.service.ts and token.service.ts.
